input.text: For what it's worth, although this problem might be a bit misplaced, I think it is very nice. The setup of coordinates in the problem statement hides a purely geometric solution in reality. Alternatively if you didn't see the slick solution at first you can just add up the cubes on two of the sides, minus the column of cubes that they both share.
